purpose: Development diagnostic; source-export validation folders, not verified C validation. No test images used.
matching: IoU >= 0.5, one-to-one greedy matching in descending prediction confidence. Unmatched predictions with >=50% prediction area inside rubble ignored-region boxes are excluded.
size_bins: GT area after aspect-preserving scaling longest side to 640: small <32^2, medium <96^2, large otherwise. Recall bins only, not COCO AP.
limitations: No verified provenance for C merged train/val; these originals may have been seen during training.
Excluded exact test and validation duplicates; near-duplicate, source-video grouping, and train-overlap audits not completed.
Original human-class mapping follows prior repair; in-car annotation semantics need review.
Unknown weather/occlusion conditions are not inferred from class names.
Unmatched predictions are annotation-relative candidates, not independently reviewed false positives.
Size/class subgroup precision is not meaningful because unmatched predictions cannot be assigned to a GT subgroup.
Not a deployed alert, clinical, survivor-status, or full video performance test.
